successCriteria.note: docs/design/palette.md derives every brand value from build/icon.png (crimson #b51a1f, bone #f2d7ae, brass #d69b4a, gunmetal #28211d, lens #84c20a; cited pixels re-read independently). DM-6 applied it; theme.contrast.test.ts checks all :root color tokens against the doc.

styles.test.ts fails on any hex color in renderer CSS outside the :root block of styles.css; it passes. No hex literal remains in non-test renderer TS (the edge arrowheads now use var(--edge)/var(--edge-waiting)).

Sidebar brand shows the tech-priest with "All hail the machine spirit" under the name (DM-5); the welcome and onboarding screens show the mascot (DM-9). Screenshots scratchpad/shot/shots/final/01-welcome.png, 02-onboarding.png, 03-folder-home.png.

Palette doc section 4 collision rules (no state on the crimson hue; accepted moved to jade away from the lens). workspace.palette.test.ts asserts the 7 ticket tones and 7 run tones resolve to distinct colors; every card and pill keeps its text label; Blocked added to the legend. Screenshot scratchpad/shot/shots/final/07-plan-graph-running.png shows accepted, in review, running, ready, waiting and failed together.

theme.contrast.test.ts enforces the palette doc sections 5.1 to 5.5 (70 pairs): body text and state labels at least 4.5:1 on their surfaces, --faint and --ring at least 3:1; guard tests prove it fails when a token breaks contrast.
All six pass on the integrated branch at 06304f1: lint passed, typecheck passed, test passed, fireguard passed, deadcode passed, build passed, smoke:mcp passed.

src/integration/epicDrafts.test.ts drives the desktop handlers over two folders and asserts saving, discarding, status changes and queueing on one epic leave every other epic's summary and draft unchanged; the reported symptom (an edited epic reopening in the Saved view) is fixed and covered by workspaceState and EpicWorkspace.draft tests (DM-11).

Sprint labels reserve their height and clamp long goals (DM-21, layout tests; scratchpad/shot/shots/final/05-long-goal-graph.png). A completed epic offers a read-only Epic report that survives the final approval and loads from portable records (DM-22). Its text wraps at a reading width at 1024, 1280 and 1440 px (DM-23; scratchpad/shot/shots/final/06-completed-overview-1280.png).

outcome.summary: Dark Mechanicus now looks like it belongs to the Adeptus Mechanicus. Its palette comes from the tech-priest icon: crimson primary, brass secondary, bone display ink, gunmetal surfaces and a sparing lens green. Every color is a :root token guarded by tests for hardcoded colors, doc drift and WCAG contrast, and the mascot appears in the sidebar and on the first-run screens. Along the way, four reported bugs were fixed: drafts appearing to leave draft, sprint labels overlapping checkpoints, the vanishing completed-epic overview, and its one-word-per-line text.

title: Mechanicus UI revamp: crimson, brass and the tech-priest mascot
